description: This PHP file handles the password change functionality in a web-based user interface. It includes server-side includes, client-side JavaScript for form validation and UI interactions, and form elements for password input. The code facilitates updating user passwords with validation and user feedback.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines an instance number based on the logged-in username, returning 1 for 'mso', 3 for 'admin', and 0 for others.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to 'at_a_glance.php' to cancel password change.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to update the password configuration on the server and provides user feedback based on the response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates that the new password differs from the old one and initiates the password change process.
